profile_text.body:
Surfer is an SEO and content optimization platform founded in 2017 and headquartered in Wrocław, Poland. The company describes itself as an AI visibility platform built for marketing and SEO teams, with tools covering content writing and editing, keyword research, topical authority analysis, competitive research, and real-time monitoring of rankings across both traditional search engines and AI-driven platforms such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Claude. Its core product, Surfer SEO, uses NLP analysis and content scoring to help users produce and optimize content, and the company says it offers EU-hosted options for data residency.

Surfer positions its platform around what it calls an AI Search Operating System, which it describes as a closed-loop workflow designed to improve visibility in both Google search and large language model citations. The site argues that LLMs select content based on structure, depth, and credibility rather than keyword density, and Surfer's tooling is presented as targeting those signals. User testimonials on the site cite outcomes including more than doubling blog content production while reducing the cost of producing SEO content by more than four times. Additional tools listed on the site include a Chrome extension, an AI writing interface, an AI detector, an AI humanizer, and an AI search volatility tracker.

The held facts confirm Surfer has been tracked on theworldofai.org with its profile verified as of August 2026, and no litigation or MCP server registrations are currently on record for the company.
